# NV-Gateway

> Neural Proxy & Desktop HUD — a Windows desktop app, OpenAI and Anthropic dual gateway, and local AI proxy for NVIDIA NGC/NIM: 100+ models behind unified OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, with zero rate limits failover, DPAPI encryption at rest, and zero mandatory telemetry. Specification and integration parameters for AI models, agents, and LLM crawlers.

**Overview**

NV-Gateway is a high-performance local reverse proxy, Local Anthropic Messages Proxy, and NVIDIA NGC Anthropic API adapter running on Windows. It exposes OpenAI-compatible (`/v1/chat/completions`) and Anthropic-compatible (`/v1/messages`) endpoints on `127.0.0.1:12004`, rotating across multiple API keys with zero rate limits failover, DPAPI encryption at rest, and dynamic reasoning capability discovery. This enables Claude Code with NVIDIA NIM as well as autonomous multi-agent swarms with zero external middleware.

**Base URLs**
- Gateway Endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:12004/v1` (OpenAI & Anthropic) or `http://127.0.0.1:12004` (as `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`)
- Admin API: `http://127.0.0.1:12005/admin`
- Health / Readiness: `http://127.0.0.1:12004/health`, `http://127.0.0.1:12004/ready`

**Supported Protocols & Endpoints**

**1. OpenAI Chat Completions**
- Route: `POST /v1/chat/completions`
- Authentication: Optional `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
- Supported features: Full streaming SSE (`stream: true`), function/tool calling, structured output, temperature, max_tokens.
- Reasoning Parameters:
  - `reasoning_effort`: "none" | "minimal" | "low" | "medium" | "high" | "xhigh" | "max"
  - `chat_template_kwargs`: `{"enable_thinking": true}`

**2. Anthropic Messages API Facade (Local Anthropic Messages Proxy)**
- Route: `POST /v1/messages`
- Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:12004` or `http://127.0.0.1:12004/v1`
- Authentication: Optional `x-api-key: <token>` or `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
- Protocol: Automatic bidirectional translation between Anthropic Messages schema and NVIDIA OpenAI backend, including tool/function calling, multi-turn conversations, multi-part prompt blocks, system prompts, thinking/reasoning parameters, and streaming SSE events.
- Compatibility: Claude Code (`claude-code` CLI), Anthropic TypeScript/Python SDKs, Claude Desktop.

**3. Model Discovery & Metadata**
- Route: `GET /v1/models`
- Output: List of available NVIDIA NGC models enriched with:
  - `context_length`: Maximum input context window (e.g. 131072 for GLM-4/5, 128000 for LLaMA 3.3).
  - `max_completion_tokens`: Maximum generated token limit (e.g. 4096 to 16384).
  - `capabilities`: Modalities and supported reasoning control levels.

**Key Supported Model Families**
- **Z-AI GLM**: `z-ai/glm-5.2`, `z-ai/glm-4-9b-chat` (Supports thinking/reasoning modes).
- **Meta Llama**: `meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct`, `meta/llama-3.1-405b-instruct`, `meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct`.
- **DeepSeek**: `deepseek-ai/deepseek-r1`, `deepseek-ai/deepseek-v3`.
- **NVIDIA Nemotron**: `nvidia/nemotron-4-340b-instruct`, `nvidia/llama-3.1-nemotron-70b-instruct`.
- **Qwen**: `qwen/qwen2.5-72b-instruct`, `qwen/qwen2.5-coder-32b-instruct`.
- **Mistral**: `mistralai/mistral-large-2-instruct`, `mistralai/mixtral-8x22b-instruct`.

**Client Configuration Reference**

**Claude Code (`claude-code` CLI)**
- Environment: `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:12004`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=local-nv-gateway`
- Windows PowerShell:
  ```powershell
  $env:ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:12004"
  $env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY  = "local-nv-gateway"
  claude --model z-ai/glm-5.2
  ```
- Linux / macOS Bash:
  ```bash
  export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:12004"
  export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="local-nv-gateway"
  claude --model meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct
  ```

**OpenCode (`~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`)**
```json
{
  "provider": {
    "nvidia-gateway": {
      "type": "openai-compatible",
      "options": {
        "baseURL": "http://127.0.0.1:12004/v1",
        "apiKey": "local-nv-gateway"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Cline / Roo Code**
- API Provider: `OpenAI Compatible`
- Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:12004/v1`
- API Key: `local-nv-gateway`

**Cursor**
- Custom Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:12004/v1`
- API Key: `local-nv-gateway`

**Aider**
- Environment: `OPENAI_API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:12004/v1`, `OPENAI_API_KEY=local-nv-gateway`
- Command: `aider --model openai/z-ai/glm-5.2`

**Continue (`~/.continue/config.json`)**
- Provider: `openai`
- `apiBase`: `http://127.0.0.1:12004/v1`
- `apiKey`: `local-nv-gateway`

**Security & Privacy**
- Runs exclusively on local loopback interface (`127.0.0.1`).
- Key storage is encrypted with Windows DPAPI (`%APPDATA%\NV-Gateway\keys.json`).
- Zero telemetry tracking. Log scrubbing automatically redacts keys, auth tokens, and sensitive query strings.

## Integrations

- [Claude Code](https://github.com/HaYkMnE/NV-Gateway/blob/main/README.md#1-claude-code-claude-code-cli): Anthropic CLI env vars (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) and --model flag
- [OpenCode](https://github.com/HaYkMnE/NV-Gateway/blob/main/README.md#2-opencode): provider config block with baseURL
- [Cline / Roo Code](https://github.com/HaYkMnE/NV-Gateway/blob/main/README.md#3-cline--roo-code-vs-code-extension): OpenAI-compatible provider setup, model IDs
- [Cursor](https://github.com/HaYkMnE/NV-Gateway/blob/main/README.md#4-cursor): custom OpenAI base URL and API key
- [Aider](https://github.com/HaYkMnE/NV-Gateway/blob/main/README.md#5-aider): terminal env vars and --model flag
- [Continue](https://github.com/HaYkMnE/NV-Gateway/blob/main/README.md#6-continue-vs-code--jetbrains): config.json model entries
- [Windsurf](https://github.com/HaYkMnE/NV-Gateway/blob/main/README.md#7-windsurf--openclaw): OpenAI provider base URL and key
- [OpenClaw](https://github.com/HaYkMnE/NV-Gateway/blob/main/README.md#7-windsurf--openclaw): OpenAI provider base URL and key
